blocks.text: Claude Code 提示：如果一项任务变得比你预期的更难，在 Claude 工作时输入 ultrathink。它会提高该轮剩余部分的努力程度。在最新版本的终端中可用。

blocks.text: Claude Code tip: if a task turns out harder than you expected, type ultrathink while Claude is working. It raises the effort for the rest of that turn. In the terminal on the latest release.
